messages:
alyssa: FYI I uploaded the Q4 recurring-root-cause catalog and a short synthesis. We need to assign owners for the top 5 recurring themes and put rough timelines on the action items. Can folks skim and call dibs? https://redwood.internal/sheets/q4-rootcause-catalog :eyes:

sanjay: thanks — will take the "model cache evictions under load" theme. i'll propose a fix + timeline by EOD friday.

marie: i'll pick up "incorrect retry surfaces causing overload" — looks like 3 postmortems already. planning to meet with sdk and client teams tomorrow. @sanjay fyi might overlap on rate-limit fallback logic.

jasper: i'll own "slow cold-start on dedicated nodes" — my first step is a benchmark matrix to capture p95 cold-starts across GPU types. aiming for a PR with perf tests in two weeks. :thumbsup:

carl: adding myself to "alert fatigue / noisy pages" — will audit current pager rules and propose consolidation. target: draft rule set next Tue.

alyssa: great. for tracking, let's create a single epic per theme in JIRA and link postmortems. please add the epic link back to the sheet column B (Epic). i'll do a pass and seed epics for anything without an owner.

incident-bot: Summary created: incident-catalog-Q4-1805554321 (3 themes, 12 incidents referenced). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/catalog/1805554321

marie: quick question — for the retry surface item, do we want to change client SDK defaults or add server-side circuit breakers? I can prototyping server side first if that's agreeable.

sanjay: server-side circuit breaker seems lower blast radius. i can collaborate on a prototype. also we should update the runbook: line 42 has an incorrect link to the rate limiter config.

alyssa: agreed on server-side first. marie + sanjay, can you pair and aim for a small canary by Nov 9? mark the timeline in the sheet as 'canary 2023-11-09' if that works.

jasper: note on cold-starts — i found an easy win: preload KV cache for frequent model shards during node init. patch is trivial but we need to validate memory impact. i'll include mem perf numbers in the PR.

carl: regarding alert fatigue, here's a small checklist i'm proposing: 1) dedupe duplicate alerts, 2) add query-level samples to reduce noise, 3) apply rate-limited escalations. will post checklist in thread.

alyssa: action items summary (from this thread):
- model cache evictions: owner sanjay, timeline EOD Fri for proposal, epic assigned by alyssa
- retry/circuit breakers: owners marie + sanjay, canary target 2023-11-09
- cold-starts: owner jasper, perf PR in 2 weeks
- alert consolidation: owner carl, draft rules Tue
- i will seed missing epics & follow up next Monday with a consolidated tracker.

jasper: small note — can we add a unit in the sheet for "estimated customer impact"? makes prioritization easier.

alyssa: good idea. i've added a column 'est_cust_hrs' — please fill with rough numbers.

sanjay: filing JIRA for my theme now: RW-INC-8421. added link to sheet.

marie: created RW-INC-8422 for retry work, assigned to marie + sanjay, target canary 2023-11-09.

carl: RW-INC-8423 for alert consolidation created. assigning reviewers.

alyssa: thanks all. i'll run a weekly sync for the next 6 weeks to keep momentum. if anyone needs to shift ownership ping me. :sparkles:
